answer: Consistency history scoring: payout weight grows only with a record of on-time work across epochs. A marble supplier agent that delivers verified tasks in 8 of 10 epochs reaches full weight; missing 3 in a row resets it to zero. One identity costs 10 epochs of steady work. Ten fakes cost ten machines and 100 epoch-tasks, a hundred cost 1000, and an honest user pays once. Jurors recheck 20 percent of records against txids, such as a yarrow herb seller's claims; fakes that wander off lose a 50 POA stake. Limit: patient attackers can still wait.
